(15 matches) |highest attendance = |lowest attendance = |average attendance = |attendance = |prevseason = [[2021 China League One|2021]] |nextseason = [[2023 China League One|2023]] }} The '''2022 [[China League One]]''' ({{lang-zh|2022中国足球协会甲级联赛}}) was the 19th season of the [[China League One]], the second tier of the [[Chinese football league system|Chinese football league pyramid]], since its establishment in 2004. ==Format== On 12 May 2022, the [[Chinese Football Association]] announced the format of the season.{{cite web|url=https://m.dongqiudi.com/article/2753103.html|title=2022赛季中甲联赛抽签分组出炉，南通支云落位唐山赛区！|work=Dongqiudi|date=12 May 2022|access-date=12 May 2022|language=zh}} The season will be divided into 4 stages (8, 8, 8 and 10 rounds respectively). In the first stage, 18 teams will be divided into three groups. The hosts will be allocated to each group and other teams will be drawn based on last season's rankings.
